company.name: Alberto Bonizzi AG

company.fit_rationale: A long-established Zurich importer of branded European food that already handles sweets and gifting. Its Italian focus means Diablo would be a stretch beyond its core, so tier 2.

company.name: Arslan GmbH
company.distributes: Turkish and ethnic food: confectionery and snacks, dairy, grains, spreads, drinks, spices, tea and coffee.
company.channels_supplied: Ethnic grocery and trade customers; Zurich coverage not confirmed.

company.name: Bio Partner Schweiz AG
company.distributes: Organic food wholesale: about 10,000 products across grocery and fresh lines.
company.channels_supplied: About 4,000 customers in retail, gastronomy and industry, mainly organic shops; also runs its own organic shops including Witikon in Zurich.

company.name: Biofair-Naturapart GmbH

company.name: Columbus Vertriebs AG
company.distributes: Confectionery and snacks; juices, soft drinks and water (linked to ALO drink).
company.channels_supplied: Not confirmed.

company.name: F. Uhlmann-Eyraud SA

company.name: Fortura AG
